row.team_price_text: Starting at $299/mo billed monthly, 2 users included; extra users $39/mo each
row.evidence: Keap users are added by an admin under Settings > Users and Permissions with an emailed invite; Keap's 'Single Sign-On' is a shared Thryv/Keap email-and-password login, and no SCIM or SAML is documented.
row.notes: No SCIM and no customer-IdP SAML/OIDC. Keap's 'SSO' is Thryv's unified login for Thryv and Keap products (one email and password), plus Google sign-in for Gmail addresses; neither counts as sso_plan. Pricing is a single platform price: starting at $299/mo billed monthly with 2 user licences and 1,500 contacts; additional users $39/mo each (monthly only, so recorded as monthly; per-user field null because the base is a bundle). Public REST API (OAuth 2.0) can list, create (invite) and update users and read user groups, but has no delete or deactivate endpoint. Okta OIN lists Keap as SWA (password vaulting) only. Help centre moved to learn.thryv.com after the Thryv acquisition. Status none by absence (medium).

plans.name: Keap
plans.price_text: Starting at $299/mo (Billed monthly); 2 user licenses included, additional users $39/month per user
plans.notes: Single platform price; help centre still refers to editions (Keap Ultimate for User Teams).

scim.notes: No SCIM documented on keap.com, developer.keap.com (REST v1/v2 OpenAPI specs) or the Thryv/Keap help centre.

capabilities.notes: POST /rest/v1/users creates and invites a user (email, given_name, admin, partner). v2 PATCH updates profile fields only (name, email, phone, address, title, time zone). User groups are read-only (list/retrieve). No delete or deactivate endpoint seen in either spec.

webhooks_user_events.notes: REST hooks exist (GET /rest/v1/hooks/event_keys) but event keys are returned at runtime; whether any are user events is not documented in the spec.

limitations.text: No API endpoint to delete or deactivate a user; v2 user groups are read-only.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SWA as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Keap or Infusionsoft tutorial in the Microsoft Entra SaaS app tutorial TOC.

fallbacks.other_sync: Thryv unified login (one email and password across Thryv and Keap); Google sign-in for Gmail sign-in addresses.
